W100 source_hash provenance fix — /verify flags DRIFT by construction today (seeder finding 2026-09-30): source_hash stores sha256 of the job PAYLOAD, not the source_ref file, so any resolvable source_ref drifts immediately. Fix: /enqueue (producer side) hashes the source_ref FILE at enqueue time (producer has repo access; distiller only sees payload) and passes it through the queue into the row; verify then compares live file vs stored hash = real drift detection. Also normalize code_origin explanatory suffixes out of source_ref. Small: enqueue contract + ports pass-through + tests.

W101 validate + fix ship-vs-daemon merge race (from W94 A/B agent-B analysis — UNVERIFIED model output, treat as lead): agent claims fleet-loop ship mode aborts MERGE_HEAD unconditionally (~line 784-788) while cycle() consults mergeRunnerAlive(), and the board /api/ship veto checks lanes/sessions but has NO merge-state check (fleet-board ~2634-2688) — so a one-click ship can abort a live daemon ladder mid-flight, FAIL-strike the innocent branch, and overwrite the shared .fleet/merge-active marker so the next cycle misclassifies the daemon's live merge as debris. VALIDATE against source first; if real: ship mode should apply the same mergeRunnerAlive() check + veto, and the marker overwrite needs guarding. Runners-up from same analysis (lower priority): setState non-CAS done-vs-reclaim interleave; work done worktree auto-retire lacks liveness guard.

W102 hub v2 — dosu mechanics (evidence: W94/W97 A/B + dosu mechanism study 0ed2f8d; pull-style query-then-act measured +45% tok on comprehension, +6.8% on work — never pays). THREE DELTAS, source-traced from dosu: (1) STANDING RULE with exclusive taxonomy + docs-skip clause: install fleet-knowledge.md (rules dir) — read_knowledge BEFORE non-trivial work on architecture/conventions/decisions/gotchas/incidents, SKIP trivial edits AND skip when repo docs already cover it (anti-double-spend). (2) SUBSTITUTION CONTRACT on ingest: reject facts derivable from a single file read ('what the repo teaches'); store pointers into docs/ + only the non-obvious residue (incidents, cross-repo tribal knowledge, past-gate protocols); render hits as PROSE CARDS with provenance, not JSON.stringify. (3) TRUST AS PERMISSION-TO-ACT: render age_days + source_hash-verified + provenance per hit; verified hits may be acted on WITHOUT re-verification (kill the blanket-verify instruction); candidate-state facts alone require checking. Plus: session-end capture stays mechanically budgeted (existing queue + redaction is the base).

W95 belt route hints — /api/route v2 vocabulary (owner spec 2026-09-30): callers attach a hint to the routing request; two strengths: MUST <constraint> = hard requirement, no healthy match → machine-readable ERROR {error, why} (no silent substitution — enterprise honesty doctrine); PREFER <constraint> = soft ordering, degrades gracefully (PREFER LOCAL REASONING → role-matched local first, else best cloud role-match; 'just PREFER LOCAL' can default to anything local). Constraint dimensions: LOCAL (locality-registered targets), CLOUD, REASONING/task-type (role match: distill/menial/code/general/reasoning), SPEED (lowest proven latency). Combinable: 'MUST CLOUD', 'PREFER LOCAL REASONING', 'PREFER SPEED'. No hint = current policy (healthy → proven avg_ms → load). BELT SIDE: route-policy.ts parses hint, filters/orders candidates, error path for MUST-no-match. SUSPENDERS SIDE: knowledge-worker BeltDistillClient sends PREFER LOCAL REASONING for distill (replaces the interim INGEST_LLM_URL pin — belt decides again, local-first), advise.ts keeps default policy. Audit logs the hint + resolved target + whether PREFER degraded or MUST errored.

W95 belt route hints — FINAL grammar (owner 2026-09-30, deterministic + fast, zero LLM in the routing decision): hint := VERB LOCATion? MODEL? TAGS* — VERB: prefer|must (must = hard: no healthy fit → machine-readable ERROR {error, why}, never silently substitute; prefer = soft: best fit first, degrade by policy). LOCATION: local|cloud|host:<server> (a set server). MODEL: model:<id-or-glob> (specific model). TAGS: small tag cloud belt regexps against target tags/capabilities to find a fit (reasoning, distill, code, danish, menial, ocr, …) — regexp fit = microseconds, deterministic. Examples: 'must cloud', 'prefer local reasoning', 'prefer host:nas model:qwen*', 'prefer speed'. No hint = current policy (healthy → proven avg_ms → load). BELT: route-policy.ts parses + filters + orders + MUST-error path; audit logs hint, resolved target, degraded|errored. SUSPENDERS: knowledge-worker BeltDistillClient sends 'prefer local distill reasoning' (REPLACES the interim INGEST_LLM_URL pin — belt decides again, local-first); advise.ts keeps default policy.
